item.title: SCV 101: Carmen Garcia, Executive Director of Family Promise
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda sits down with Carmen Garcia to learn about how she was born in Mexico, then moved to Pasadena where she grew up. She graduated from Pasadena High School before going to Watterson College to study legal secretarial which led her to work at the non-profit the Mexican American Legal Defense and Educational Fund. item.title: Cello Centric Performs Concert at the Open Book
item.description: Cello Centric is a group of accomplished Southern-Californian musicians that write and perform cello-centric compositions. On June 27, 2025 the group held a concert at the former Open Book in the Canyon Country Plaza where they performed original compositions with a variety of instruments including violins, violas, the dulcimer, a bass viol, and of course cellos
